claims_empty_reason: Contract wp-5559-01 sets objective.register_assets=true and classify_report_type=false, notes state that `claims 允许为空数组`, and the constraints include no_forced_claim_generation=true and do_not_mark_claims_as_verified=true. This work package registers asset identity only (report_id, markdown byte hash, declared attachments/artefacts); claim extraction belongs to a downstream work package, so an empty claims array is the complete result rather than an omission.
observations: Record title equals the contract title, while the markdown H1 is the shorter `# IN10-A1 · 四态冰场合成器成熟化（field_synth）`; downstream consumers keying on title equality instead of report_id would miss this record.

The report body links five figures (fig1..fig5) but the record declares only four (fig1, fig2, fig4, fig5): fig3_ridges.png is absent from the record figure list while section 7 still declares its file and a truncated sha256.
record.mission_id is 4908 even though the package contract declares mission_id: null; recorded as observed, not reconciled here.
The report embeds one fenced json block (machine-criteria summary); it parses and its digest is a 64-hex string whose prefix agrees with both truncated digests in the prose.
Every platform figure/artefact endpoint probed returned HTTP 404, so no artifact bytes (and therefore no artifact hash) could be checked from this record.
The domain extent is stated as 2.05 km while 1024 x 2.0 m = 2.048 km: equal at the stated two-decimal rounding, so this is rounding, not a numeric inconsistency.
limitations: Registration only: no claim/evidence extraction, no report-type classification, no verification marks (verification is computed by the platform gate).
source_hash scope = UTF-8 bytes of the markdown string returned by the platform API; any whitespace change in the stored markdown invalidates it.
Artefact hashes appear in the report only as truncated 16-hex prefixes; the full digests are unresolvable from this record and are not asserted.
Artefacts live in the producing repository (ship-performance-platform), which is not checked out here; their content was not read, hashed or trusted.
The numeric cross-checks are arithmetic/structural re-derivations of numbers the report itself declares; they are not a re-run of the ice-field synthesiser and say nothing about physical validity.
Locator char offsets are offsets into the decoded markdown string, not byte offsets of a file on disk.
